text:
eli Heads-up: NimbusCloud says they can spare 3 A100s in eu-west1 for ~72h. Can we grab 3 for a short perf benchmark and model-sweep? Low QPS, ephemeral. Need quick infra + finance thumbs. @rebecca you okay with eu-west1? :globe_with_meridians:
rebecca Do we need NFS or PVCs? Also any data residency flags for eu?
eli No NFS, artifacts to S3 (eu bucket). Residency: it's fine for test data but not customer PII. We'll scrub.
infra-bot Note: cross-region vendor allocations require an alloc ticket and an infra PR referencing `region=eu-west1` and `gpu_type=a100`. See https://internal.redwood/allocs/docs.
omar I'll start the infra PR if finance ok. Also prefer single AZ eu-west1-b only to keep perf consistent.
procure-bot NimbusCloud ETA: ~24h to allocate racks. Requires vendor PO if total > $1.5k. Ticket: NC-2209.
finance-bot Quick check: temporary PO possible with cost center and approver. Need estimated hours x GPU or a not-to-exceed amount.
eli Estimate: 3 GPUs x 8h sweep + 4h buffer = 36 GPU-hours. If vendor rate ~ $35/hr => ~ $1.3k. Recommend cap $1.6k. Cost center: cc-452. Approver: @rebecca.
rebecca Approved up to $1.6k for this benchmark, conditional on: 1) runs auto-terminate at 12h, 2) telemetry enabled, 3) SRE notified. :white_check_mark:
sre Please keep an eye on tail-latency. Tag me in the incident channel if we see >50ms p50 regression.
omar Will open PR and add `az=eu-west1-b` label + auto-terminate at 12h. Draft snippet: ```resource "redwood_alloc" "nc_canary_euw1" { pool = "perf-canary" gpu = "a100" count = 3 window = "2026-05-10T08:00Z/2026-05-10T20:00Z" labels = { az = "eu-west1-b" } owner = "omar"}```
infra-bot Reminder: include smoke test that fails fast if node join > 6m and attach monitoring hooks to `canary/perf` dashboard.
eli I'll add a smoke job that exits non-zero on startup >6m and pushes metrics to canary/perf. Also will scrub logs post-run.
procure-bot Filling PO uplift form: https://procure.redwood/forms/po-uplift?ticket=NC-2209 1 tagging @finance-bot to generate PO once form complete.
finance-bot Will queue PO after PR references cost center + cap. Expect PO in ~8-10h.
rebecca Assigning infra review to @omar and billing to @finance-bot. If vendor slips, fallback plan: use local dev-a100 pool with only 1-2 GPUs and run reduced sweep.
eli Sounds good. I'll follow up once PR is up and PO is submitted. Thanks all. :rocket:
